title: ACD - Failed to authenticate decrypted block
body:
Running the latest beta, Ubuntu x64, Amazon Cloud Storage.

rclone mount acde: /home/x/cloud-plain --allow-other --no-modtime --dir-cache-time=2m --verbose --log-file=/home/x/rclone.log

I saw there was closed issues on this before, but it still seems to be happening again with a large number of seeks. It's very rare now though, Plex Media Scanner is the one making all the calls again:
